You wake up on the last bus. Every seat is empty. And outside, there's only fog.
Your phone says eleven forty seven. No signal. Your stop was an hour ago.
No streets. No houses. No lights. The bus just keeps driving.
You press the stop button. Ding. The sign above the driver flickers.
The driver doesn't turn around. He just holds out his hand. Ticket, please.
You look at your ticket. One way. No destination.

text: Then, from the very last row, a whisper. Don't give him your ticket.
Would you give him the ticket? Comment yes or no.
